explication: Microduck is the runtime for a small biped robot: robotd drives the motors and runs learned policies, while separate daemons provide input, configuration, sensing, media, and reversible updates. The main user path is gamepad or remote command → robotd → movement or skill. The graph also preserves the documented camera/WebRTC, depth-sensing, connectivity, and update capabilities. Some daemon-to-daemon links are documented only at a high level; unsampled implementation details are not inferred.
